versions.note: Jørgen made this track with Suno and supplied it on 2026-10-17 ("this is a fine day outdoor song"); his pick is the approval. The loop is the whole song from its top to bar 44 (about 107 s), where the outro starts on the opening's chords, so the outro is replaced by the start.
versions.prompt: 穏やかな日常 ("Calm everyday life"): a calm, sunny instrumental at about 99 BPM, 120 s as supplied, with a short fade at the end.
